subject: Stage refresh + quickfire standup: weekly forecast submission
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Stage refresh + quickfire standup: weekly forecast submission

Team —

Quick reminder: weekly forecast submission window opens today at 9am PT and closes Friday EOD. This week I want a focused stage refresh followed by a 20-minute quickfire standup to lock commits and call out risky deals. Please do the following by Thursday 5pm PT: 

1) Update stage / close date / ARR on any deals that have moved in the last 7 days.
2) Flag deals you want reviewed in the standup by adding a row to commit_flags_20280718.csv (seen attached).
3) Upload a refreshed view to the shared Drive folder (link below) with the Q3_quickfire template.

Agenda for the quickfire (Wed 10:30am PT):
- 10:30–10:35: Quick call in, alignment on goals for the week
- 10:35–10:50: Top 6 deals (2 minutes each) — current stage, gap to commit, blocker
- 10:50–10:55: Action owners & follow-ups

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-standup-link
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/forecast-q3-2028

Attachments: Q3_forecast_quickfire_template_v3.xlsx (template), commit_flags_20280718.csv (simple list)

Keep updates terse — we want signal, not long notes. If you have a deal with procurement/legal blockers, flag it in the CSV and set the "need escalation" column.

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 18 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stage refresh + quickfire standup: weekly forecast submission

Thanks — added a couple of agenda items. Two quick asks: 

- Can we reserve 2 slots for any procurement escalations? Last week we had one that spilled.
- I'll upload my team's sheet to the Drive by 3pm PT.

Also attaching a short pre-standup checklist I use to triage commit risk — feel free to borrow.

Attachments: prestand_checklist_1pager.pdf (one-pager)

Quick update from my side before the standup: I uploaded the East region sheet and flagged two deals for review (rows 4 and 9 in commit_flags_20280718.csv).

- Deal 1: ACME Corp (PO pending legal review) — moved to Procurement Review (was Negotiation). Gap: final SOW signoff, procurement timeline uncertain.
- Deal 2: Northline Partners — pushing commit to next month; probability lowered to 50%.

I've added brief notes in the Drive doc and attached a one-line summary here. Please call out if we should push for an exec intro on ACME or queue a pre-signed PO workflow.

[Attachment: east_region_upload_summary.txt]

Perfect — thanks for the uploads and the flags. Final details:

- Standup confirmed: Wed 10:30–10:50am PT (please be punctual).
- I've reserved two escalation slots for procurement/legal; we'll slot ACME into the first escalation if legal is still holding.
- Action owners: Ben (ACME legal follow-up), Marissa (Northline pricing alternative), Karthik (exec intro queue).
- If you cannot make the standup, add a 1–2 line summary in the Drive file and mark who will speak.

One more ask: for any deals with open compliance/security questions, add a short note in the template under "security_status" — we want visibility before commit.

See you on the call.

Thanks,
